meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: Claude 会为项目加装 Webex 渠道：从 channels 分支复制适配器和注册测试、追加注册导入、安装适配器依赖，然后构建并运行注册测试。机器人 Token 和 webhook 密钥需你手动在 Webex 门户创建后提供。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加 Webex 渠道（如在 /setup 流程中，或用 /manage-channels 接入前后）时触发，它会按 Apply 步骤改动 src/channels 并安装依赖。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Webex 渠道支持
say.note: 会复制适配器并跑构建与注册测试

say.text: 跑一下 webex-registration 测试，看适配器有没有注册上
say.note: 测试红说明导入行或依赖出了偏差

say.text: Webex 里的消息收不到，帮我查一下 webhook 配置
say.note: 会核对 webhook 地址、资源和签名密钥

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Webex channel to the project: copies the adapter and its registration test from the channels branch, appends the registration import, installs the adapter dependency, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Webex support to NanoClaw, e.g. while running /setup, or before wiring the channel with /manage-channels. It then edits src/channels and installs the dependency.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel support to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, then builds and runs the registration test

say_en.text: Run the webex-registration test to check the adapter is registered
say_en.note: Red means the import or dependency drifted

say_en.text: Messages from Webex never arrive — check my webhook setup
say_en.note: Checks the webhook URL, resource and signature secret
